title: Normalization of the pulled quotient-tower completion unit
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $g:X'\to X$ be a morphism between noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. On their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_W=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_W$ for $W=X,X'$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use module sheaves and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and sheaf tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $c_g:g^{-1}B_X\to B_{X'}$ be the projection-defined map of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and put $P_gK=B_{X'}\otimes^L_{g^{-1}B_X}g^{-1}K$. For every intrinsically derived $\varpi$-complete $K\in D(B_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], let $\widehat P_gK$ and $\gamma_{g,K}:P_gK\to\widehat P_gK$ be exactly the completed pullback and unit of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. For $W=X,X'$ write $\Delta_W$ for the constant strict tower functor and
$$\mathcal T_W(M)=\Delta_WM\otimes^L_{\Delta_WB_W}((A/\varpi^n)_W)_n,$$
with strict quotient transitions and quotient augmentation $i_{W,M}:\Delta_WM\to\mathcal T_W(M)$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $\lambda_M:M\to R\lim\Delta_WM$ be the specified constant-tower unit and set $u_M=R\lim(i_{W,M})\lambda_M$, with $R\lim$ the derived inverse-limit functor [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback, def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit, prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality]. The canonical $c_g$ is an isomorphism, compatible with every finite quotient and transition. There is a natural isomorphism of actual derived strict towers
$$\tau_K:Lg^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}\mathcal T_X(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal T_{X'}(P_gK)$$
whose value on flat-term K-flat representatives is the ordinary tensor/pullback comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower]. It satisfies the augmentation equation $\tau_K Lg^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}(i_{X,K})=i_{X',P_gK}$ under the canonical constant-tower identification. For $j_K=R\lim(\tau_K)$, a natural isomorphism from $\widehat P_gK$ to $R\lim\mathcal T_{X'}(P_gK)$, the equation of actual derived morphisms is
$$j_K\gamma_{g,K}=u_{P_gK}.$$
Neither completeness of $P_gK$ nor invertibility of $\gamma_{g,K}$ is a hypothesis or a conclusion here.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image] with $u=g$ and $Q_n=A/\varpi^n$. These are finite commutative rings with unital quotient transitions by [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Its projection formula identifies its canonical $c_g$ with exactly the projection-defined map of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]; uniqueness of a map to the limit gives equality, not a choice of coefficient identification. Its two displayed compatibility equations give all finite projections and transitions.

proof.text: Use $c_g$ to identify coefficients. By [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], module pullback $F=g^*$ is exact and left adjoint to module direct image, and its induced ordinary derived functor is $P_g$. On strict towers exact termwise pullback computes the left derived pullback specified in [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]; it commutes with constant towers through the identity component maps. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower] to $R_Y=B_X$, $R_X=B_{X\prime}$ and $Q_{Y,n}=(A/\varpi^n)_X$, identifying its pulled coefficient tower with $(A/\varpi^n)_{X\prime}$ by Step 1. That lemma applies to these small ringed sites and unital algebra transitions, with no completeness assumption. Its natural isomorphism is the required $\tau_K$ of actual derived strict towers; its representative normalization is precisely the one requested, and its augmentation identity is $\tau_K Lg^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}(i_{X,K})=i_{X\prime,P_gK}$.

source.place: Tags 06YY (lemma-derived-base-change) and 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product); strict augmented normalization supplied by the cited existing tower lemma

proof.text: By the actual construction in [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], $\widehat P_gK=R\lim(Lg^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}\mathcal T_X(K))$ and $\gamma_{g,K}=R\lim(Lg^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}i_{X,K})\lambda_{P_gK}$, with exactly the constant-tower unit used to define $u$. Apply the functor of [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality] to Step 2. It preserves isomorphisms, so $j_K=R\lim(\tau_K)$ is a natural isomorphism, and preservation of composition gives $j_K\gamma_{g,K}=R\lim(\tau_K Lg^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}i_{X,K})\lambda_{P_gK}=R\lim(i_{X\prime,P_gK})\lambda_{P_gK}=u_{P_gK}$. This is equality of derived morphisms, obtained from the strict augmentation; it uses no invertibility of the completion unit.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q29-257c92125 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all its cited statements in full. Shape: first split of a statement-only node created by Q147 on 2026-10-22; no repair note, no new nodes, statement and stmt_deps kept, proof_deps equal to the union of the step uses, no SGA source. Step 1: lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image applies with Q_n=O_E/ϖ^n, which def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension makes finite local rings with unital transitions. Its c_{u,n} is the constant-section adjoint of prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map, so the projection-defined c_g of def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback equals its isomorphism c_u by uniqueness into the limit; the projection and transition equations hold. Step 2: def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations with c=c_g makes g^* exact, so the K-flat-class derived tower pullback Lg^*_Tow is computed termwise. lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower has small sites, an identified ring and a unital algebra tower as hypotheses, all checked; both Step 1 equations identify FQ_{Y,n} with (A/ϖ^n)_{X'} as B_{X'}-algebras, and its augmentation identity is stated under the same identification F^TowΔ=ΔF that the def uses. Step 3 is elementary: γ=Rlim(Lg^*_Tow i)λ by the def, and functoriality of Rlim (prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality) gives jγ=Rlim(τ∘Lg^*_Tow i)λ=u. The citer lem-per-rational-realization-pullback-comparison step 2 uses exactly this. Sources: Stacks 099N(5) and its proof (Lf^* commutes with ⊗^L, Lf^*Λ/I^n=Λ/I^n); BS Lemma 6.5.9(4)-(5), pp. 50-51, as context; blueprint_update of def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback (the comparison is the completion map). Edge cases g=id, K=0 and empty X' hold. The 3 tool uses of sk-thm-properbasechange generic nodes are accepted; the same nodes are already accepted tool uses elsewhere.
